task_instance: Create a new 'csv-summarizer' skill following the skill-creator guidance: a skills/public/csv-summarizer/ folder with a SKILL.md (proper YAML frontmatter containing only name+description, imperative body under 500 lines with a Quick start section), a bundled scripts/summarize_csv.py that reports row/column counts and per-column stats for a CSV file, and an agents/openai.yaml with display_name/short_description/default_prompt -- then test the script on a sample CSV and validate the skill's structure/naming rules.
blocker_detail: Minor note (not a blocker): the skill-creator's own helper scripts (scripts/init_skill.py, scripts/generate_openai_yaml.py, scripts/quick_validate.py, references/openai_yaml.md) referenced by SKILL.md were not present in the provided source bundle (only SKILL.md and LICENSE existed at benchmark/ce_sources/openai__skills__skill-creator/). This did not block the core deliverable: the skill's written guidance (frontmatter rules, naming rules, body structure, line-count limit, script/reference/asset conventions) is fully self-contained prose that a runtime agent can follow directly, so I created the skill folder and validated it by hand against the same rules those scripts would have enforced.
evidence: Created /tmp/.../scratchpad/exec_ext/openai__skills__skill-creator/skills/public/csv-summarizer/ containing SKILL.md (frontmatter: name=csv-summarizer, description=triggering text; body: Quick start + Notes, 19 lines), scripts/summarize_csv.py (stdlib-only Python), and agents/openai.yaml (display_name/short_description/default_prompt). Ran the script against a sample CSV (sample_data/employees.csv, 5 rows/3 cols) and confirmed correct output: 'Rows: 5', 'Columns: 3', 'name: text, distinct_values=5', 'department: text, distinct_values=3', 'salary: numeric, min=68000.00, max=105000.00, mean=82200.00'. Ran a manual validation script (equivalent to the missing quick_validate.py) that parsed the SKILL.md frontmatter and confirmed: only name+description keys present, name matches ^[a-z0-9-]+$ and is <64 chars, folder name matches the frontmatter name, and body is under the 500-line guidance -- output: 'All checks passed.' Deliverable verified to exist and work as specified by the skill document.
